sloka: आकाशे गणशः स्थित्वा हत्वा ताम् हरिवाहिनीम् ।अश्मशस्त्रमहावृष्ट्वा प्रापयाम् यमक्षयम् ॥६-८-१७॥।।
transliteration: ākāśe gaṇaśaḥ sthitvā hatvā tām harivāhinīm ।aśmaśastramahāvṛṣṭvā prāpayām yamakṣayam ॥6-8-17॥।।

translations.english: Staying in the sky in groups, we will rain astras, sastras and boulders on the Vanara troops and on killing them, we shall send them to the abode of God of death.
